name: mockup-studio
description: Editor de design em canvas voltado para IA, com servidor MCP completo.

scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w @mockup/core -w @mockup/snapshot-core -w @mockup/server -w @mockup/extension && playwright test -c packages/editor/playwright.config.ts --project=chromium
scripts.screenshot: npm run build -w @mockup/core -w @mockup/server && playwright test -c packages/editor/playwright.config.ts --project=screenshot
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run dist -w @mockup/desktop
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n daemon,editor -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @mockup/server" "npm run dev -w @mockup/editor"
